gold_rationale: AAV-AADC intraputaminal delivery is a mechanistically sound, clinically precedented symptomatic approach: restoring putaminal AADC improves local levodopa-to-dopamine conversion and levodopa responsiveness. Progression should be conditional on solving putaminal coverage/biodistribution, controlling enzyme dose to avoid dyskinesia from ectopic/excess dopamine (titrated against oral levodopa), managing capsid/transgene immunity and pre-existing anti-AAV antibodies, defining the levodopa-responsive advanced-PD population, selecting biomarkers/endpoints (F-DOPA/AADC PET, ON/OFF time, dyskinesia scales) and a sham-controlled design. Crucially this is symptomatic, not disease-modifying, and the irreversibility of the transgene is a real consideration. Sound rationale is not demonstrated efficacy/safety.
required_concepts: biomarkers / endpoints (AADC or F-DOPA PET, ON/OFF time) and sham control
red_flags: claims disease modification or neuroprotection from a symptomatic enzyme-restoration approach
ignores enzyme dose control / dyskinesia risk from excess or ectopic dopamine
ignores capsid/transgene immunity or pre-existing anti-AAV antibodies
ignores the need for a sham-controlled trial given PD placebo effects
